tagline: See every plugin in your estate — and how many assets each touches.
lore: The Foxhound, bred to flush quarry from cover — here it flushes out every distinct plugin in navi.db.
problem: Thousands of plugins fire across an estate. Knowing which ones, in which family, on how many assets, is the starting point for any remediation plan — and it shouldn't take a query.
does: Foxhound lists every distinct plugin in navi.db with its family and the number of assets it fires on, searchable by ID, name or family. Any plugin on assets can be handed to Amarok for a remediation plan.

glance.caption: Foxhound's results: each plugin's ID, name, family and asset count, with a Fix button to plan the remediation in Amarok.

capabilities: ID, name and family, with how many assets it fires on.
a linked row opens the plugin's full detail.
Fix sends the plugin to Amarok's remediation planner, pre-filled.
how: Foxhound runs a read-only search over the plugins in your local navi.db; results page on the server, 20 rows a page (up to 50).
who: Remediation planners sizing a fix, and analysts exploring what the scanner sees.
better: Part of the search pack. Daedalus's "top reduction plugins" and Foxhound's asset counts point at the same fixes; Amarok carries them out.
cta: Flush out the plugins that matter — and fix them from the same row.
